posts.title: I Love Making Things. I Just Don't Particularly Enjoy Making Them.
posts.description: After 25 years building software, I've realized I love creating things more than constructing them. AI software factories are separating the two, changing what it means to be a builder and opening the door to ideas we never had the time or resources to explore.

posts.title: In a Room Full of Builders, Where Are the Architects?
posts.description: Harness engineering is changing how software gets built, but our practices haven't kept up. After a year engineering without reading code and operating autonomous software factories, I've found the real constraint isn't producing software. It's architecting the systems that produce it.

posts.title: Software Was First. Expertise Is Next.
posts.description: The next big opportunity in AI is making human knowledge executable, turning the expertise, judgment, and connections inside organizations into capabilities they can scale.
